title: Premature deaths due to exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) — Eurostat SDG_11_52
summary: Annual national-level counts and rates of premature deaths attributable to PM2.5 exposure in Italy, sourced from Eurostat (ESTAT). The dataset covers 18 data points for Italy: nine years between 2005–2023 (with gaps — no 2006 data) for both number of deaths (NR) and rate (RT). Compiled under the EU SDG indicator framework (indicator 11.5.2). Data is annual with national (IT) geography only; no sub-national breakdown. Updated as of 9 December 2025. No missing cells in the requested slice.

quality_notes: Year 2006 is missing from the time series — data exists for 2005, then a gap to 2007. This appears to be how Eurostat reports this indicator (not every year).
National-level only (IT) — no NUTS2/NUTS3 or city-level breakdown. This is annual national context data, not suitable for matching hourly station readings or daily clinic visits.
Grain is annual, matching use-case need N6 (annual context). Does not meet finer-grain needs (hourly, daily).

There is a discontinuity in 2007: values before 2007 use a different methodology (WHO 2005 guidelines for comparative risk assessment) vs post-2007 (WHO 2013 guidelines). This is a known Eurostat metadata note not visible in the JSON-stat but documented in the SDG metadata — users should verify methodological breaks between years.
No status flags were present in the response (status_counts empty), suggesting no provisional or estimated values flagged.
